red_gray_chip_proxy.qualification: The 0.1 percent estimate came from 1.74 mg of chips hand-extracted from a 1.6 g dust sample after readily identifiable glass and concrete fragments were removed. It is not a site-wide random sample.

cohesive_fracture_surface_proxy.qualification: This spherical-surface calculation is a sensitivity proxy. Concrete beam fracture energy is not a validated comminution law and does not include a calibrated impact-to-fragmentation efficiency.

gravity_proxy.qualification: These are sensitivity values, not a reconstructed WTC mass-height distribution.
